mechanics.title: Flat XP costs
mechanics.description: An anvil cost of X levels is paid as the XP needed to go from level 0 to X. An enchanting table requirement of 30 costs the XP from level 27 to 30 instead of 3 levels.

mechanics.title: Config
mechanics.description: Level Base (level at which flattening starts; 0 removes all tax, 30 keeps early-game costs) and Remove Anvil Limit are configurable.

vanilla_changes.change: No Too Expensive limit; renaming costs 1 level.
Level costs are charged as XP points that do not rise with player level.

qol: Anvil repairs and enchanting stay affordable at high levels.
editor_notes: Jar is TaxFreeLevels-1.5.4-fabric-26.1 on a 26.2 pack; verify it loads. Pack's grind-enchantments config uses its own cost functions, which may not be flattened. Default Level Base not in facts.
name: Tax Free Levels
summary: Flattens anvil and enchanting-table costs so you pay the same XP regardless of your level, removes the anvil's 'Too Expensive!' limit, and makes renaming always cost 1 level.
